7 recommended clinics where you can receive medical diet in Shinjuku! Compare prices and selection methods for each treatment

 

「I want to undergo a medical diet, but there are so many types of treatments that I don't know which one to choose.」

「I want to compare clinics I can attend in Shinjuku, but I can't read the total fees in advance.」

Many people may have the same problems as mentioned above.

There are many clinics in the Shinjuku area that offer medical diets, and there is a wide range of treatments available, including GLP-1 injections, fat cooling, fat melting injections, and medical EMS, so a certain level of knowledge is required to make the choice that best suits your body type and goals.

Each treatment has its own unique structure and suitability, so going one step beyond the ``I just want to lose weight'' stage and narrowing down the treatments that suit your goals and body type is a shortcut to increasing cost-effectiveness.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

Main treatments and features of medical diets available in Shinjuku

Medical diet treatments provided in the Shinjuku area can be broadly divided intoInternal medicine approach・physical fat loss・surgical fat removalIt can be organized into three systems.

Summary of characteristics of 5 medical diet treatments in Shinjuku
  • GLP-1 injection/oral medication: A medical approach to suppress appetite and reduce body weight
  • Fat freezing: non-invasive treatment to achieve partial slimming without downtime
  • Fat-dissolving injection: Decomposes fat by injecting drugs directly into small areas
  • Medical EMS: Electrical stimulation of muscles to simultaneously increase metabolism and tone
  • Liposuction: A surgical method that can achieve significant volume reduction in a single procedure

The mechanism by which they work is fundamentally different, so even if you have the same goal of losing weight, the treatment that is suitable for you will change depending on your body shape concerns and lifestyle.

For example, the type of treatment you should choose will be different depending on whether you want to lose weight all over your body or those who only want to slim a specific area, such as your stomach or thighs.

In order to increase cost effectiveness, firstHow each treatment works and its suitabilityUnderstand the following and then take the steps to narrow down your search.

GLP-1 injections and oral medications are a medical approach to suppressing appetite and losing weight

GLP-1 injections and oral medications act on the pancreas to stimulate insulin secretion and act on the appetite center in the brain.Stay fullIt is a drug that causes

Because it allows you to reduce the amount of food you eat naturally, it is suitable for people who have a tendency to overeat that is difficult to control with willpower alone, and for people who want to lose weight all over their body.

The injection isSemaglutide(Ozempik Ugobi) andliraglutide(Victoza) is a typical example, and the oral preparation of semaglutide is used as an oral drug.

At clinics in the Shinjuku area, once-a-week self-injections are the norm, and the approximate monthly cost is10,000 to 30,000 yenThat's about it.

Although some GLP-1 preparations are available at low cost online or through personal import, there is a risk of overdosing or hypoglycemia if the quality of the product is insufficiently controlled. Be sure to use it under your doctor's prescription.

Nausea, constipation, and diarrhea are likely to occur as side effects, especiallyWeeks immediately after starting treatmenttend to be more symptomatic.

If your symptoms are severe, the dosage may need to be adjusted, so do not change the dosage on your own and consult your doctor.

Fat freezing is a non-invasive treatment specialized for partial thinning.

Fat freezing causes fat cells toAround 4-5℃This is a procedure that uses the property of selectively damaging skin at low temperatures to reduce fat in certain areas without damaging the skin or muscles.

Because no scalpel is used and the device is simply adsorbed to the skin during the treatment,There's almost no downtime, the ability to return to work on the same day of treatment is popular.

This is an easy treatment to target areas that are difficult to remove with diet or exercise, such as the stomach, flanks, thighs, and upper arms.

People who are suitable for fat freezing and people who are not suitable for it
  • ✅ Those who want to lose weight in specific areas such as the stomach, flanks, thighs, upper arms, etc.
  • ✅ Those who want to return to work on the day of treatment without downtime
  • ✅ Those who want to reduce fat cells in a way that prevents rebound
  • ❌ Those who want to feel the effects immediately after the treatment (1 to 3 months until the effects appear)
  • ❌ Those who want to significantly reduce their whole body weight

The cost per part is10,000 to 30,000 yenThere are many clinics that have equipment that can irradiate multiple areas at the same time, and the treatment time can be shortened.

until the effect appears1-3 monthsIt takes some time, so it is not suitable for those who are looking for immediate results.

Since there is no need for a special rest period after the treatment, it is a treatment that is easy to attend even for busy working adults.

Because it is an approach that reduces the number of fat cells themselves, one of its characteristics is that it is said to be difficult to rebound (there are individual differences).

Fat-dissolving injections dissolve fat by injecting medicine directly into the area of concern.

Fat dissolving injections arephosphatidylcholineThis is a treatment in which a drug whose main ingredient is deoxycholic acid or deoxycholic acid is injected directly into the fat layer to destroy and dissolve fat cells.

It can treat small areas that are difficult to apply with equipment, such as the face line, under the chin, and upper arms, so it can treat areas that are difficult to treat with fat cooling.Suitable for partial thinning。

The cost per session varies depending on the size of the area and amount of injection.10,000 to 20,000 yen, the total cost will be higher if there are multiple parts.

Estimated cost and number of hospital visits for fat-dissolving injections
  • Cost per treatment: 10,000 to 20,000 yen for one submandibular site (varies depending on site and injection amount)
  • Recommended number of visits: 3 to 5 times for the same area
  • Downtime: Swelling, redness, and induration for several days to two weeks
  • Applicable areas: Supports small areas that are difficult to reach with equipment, such as under the chin, face line, upper arms, etc.

Multiple treatments are often required to see results, so it is important to check the number of hospital visits and total costs in advance.

After the injection, swelling, redness, and induration may remain at the treatment site for several days to two weeks. Please plan to avoid treatment right before an important event.

The concentration of ingredients and risk of side effects vary depending on the type and brand of the drug, so be sure to check the contents of the drug you are using during your consultation.

Medical EMS applies electrical stimulation to muscles to promote metabolism and tightening at the same time.

Medical EMS is a treatment that irradiates muscles with high-intensity electromagnetic pulses to quickly produce strong muscle training effects that cannot be achieved through voluntary muscle contraction.

With a 30 minute treatmentMore than 20,000 timesIt is said to cause muscle contraction in the trunk, abdomen, buttocks, etc.inner muscleYou can train intensively.

By increasing muscle mass rather than directly reducing fat,Increase your basal metabolism and get a toned body shapeIt is different from other treatments in that it aims to

What is medical EMS?

A treatment that uses high-intensity electromagnetic pulses to forcibly contract muscles, achieving more than 20,000 muscle contractions in 30 minutes. Rather than losing weight, aim for a toned body by training your inner muscles and increasing your basal metabolism.

It is suitable for those who want to focus on changes in body shape rather than weight numbers, and those who aim to recover their core after giving birth.

The cost per time is20,000 to 50,000 yenHowever, in order to maintain the effectiveness, regular treatment is required.

It is often used in combination with fat freezing and GLP-1, making it a complementary option when you want to lose weight and tone up at the same time.

Liposuction is a surgical method that can achieve significant volume reduction in a single procedure.

Liposuction involves making small incisions in the skin.cannulaThis is a surgical procedure that physically removes fat cells by inserting a thin tube called a fat tube.

Compared to other treatments, it removes the fat cells themselves in one treatment.Large volume change in a short period of timeYou can get

It is suitable for those who want to treat fat in a wide area such as the stomach, thighs, and upper arms at once, or for those who are at a normal weight but are concerned about volume in a specific area.

The cost varies greatly depending on the site and amount of suction, and for one site,200,000 to 600,000 yenThere are many clinics that require additional fees for anesthesia and post-operative care.

Since liposuction is a surgical procedure, severe swelling and internal bleeding will occur for 1 to 2 weeks after the procedure. Please plan your treatment with the assumption that it will take several days to return to your desk job and several weeks to resume vigorous exercise.

Considering the length of downtime and cost, consider this treatment as a treatment option for problems that cannot be addressed with other treatments.

Guidelines for treatments to choose based on your concerns and body type

When choosing a medical diet treatment, consider questions such as ``Do you want to lose weight overall?'' ``Do you want to slim down only a specific area?'' ``Do you want to shape your body while maintaining muscle mass?''Organize your purpose firstis your starting point.

Guide to choosing treatments by problem type
  • Overall weight loss is the goal → GLP-1 injections are the first option
  • Slimming of the lower abdomen, upper arms, and thighs → Fat cooling/fat dissolving injections
  • Concerned about loss of muscle mass and loss of body shape → Medical EMS

Even if it is the same medical diet,GLP-1 injectionis a medical procedure that affects appetite and metabolism, while fat cooling and fat-dissolving injections are procedures that physically work directly on fat cells.

Since the mechanisms are different, if there is a mismatch with your body shape or lifestyle, it will be difficult to get the results you expect even if you spend money.

Below, we will outline the treatments that are suitable for each type of problem.

If overall weight loss is your goal, GLP-1 is likely your first choice.

GLP-1 injections naturally reduce calorie intake by increasing the function of hormones that suppress appetite.lose weight all over the bodyThis is a treatment aimed at.

Those who want to lose weight in their entire body rather than in a specific area, orBMI is highIt is suitable for those who want to improve their lifestyle habits at the same time.

Characteristics of people suitable for GLP-1 injections
  • I want to lose weight all over my body (the goal is overall weight loss, not partial weight loss)
  • My BMI is high and I want to improve my lifestyle at the same time.
  • I want to lose weight while alleviating the hardships of dietary restrictions.
  • I have tried dieting repeatedly but was unable to continue it.

To be administered by injection,You can proceed with weight loss while alleviating the hardship of dietary restrictions.This is one of the reasons why it is often chosen by people who have repeatedly dieted.

On the other hand, the effects vary from person to person, and there are cases where side effects related to the digestive system such as nausea and loss of appetite occur, so regular follow-up by a doctor is essential.

Personally imported GLP-1 preparations have different quality control standards than those prescribed at clinics, and there is a risk that you will not be able to receive medical support if side effects occur. Be sure to get a prescription from a medical institution.

Fees continue to be administered on a monthly basis;Check the total amount with your doctor in advanceAfter that, let's start the treatment.

Fat cooling and fat dissolving injections are suitable for slimming the lower abdomen, upper arms, and thighs.

Both fat freezing and fat-dissolving injections can directly target fat cells in areas of concern.I want to reduce partial volumeIt is suitable for people.

Fat freezing is a procedure that uses special equipment to cool fat cells and release them naturally.There is almost no downtime and you can go between jobs.It is characterized by points.

Lipolytic injection is a procedure that dissolves fat cells by injecting a drug, and the main difference from fat freezing is that it is easier to treat small areas and narrow areas that are difficult to reach with equipment.

Some clinics propose a plan that combines the two treatments, using fat cooling for large areas and fat-dissolving injections for smaller areas.

Neither is suitable for the purpose of significantly reducing body weight itself, and in many cases, doctors recommend that whole-body treatment such as GLP-1 be performed first if there is overall obesity.

Since the total amount is likely to change depending on the area and number of treatments, we will inform you at the time of counseling.Check estimates for multiple sessionsPlease judge after that.

If you are concerned about loss of muscle mass or loss of body shape, consider medical EMS.

medical EMSis a treatment that uses electrical stimulation to forcibly contract muscles, working on muscle groups including inner muscles that are difficult to move with normal exercise.

Those who want to improve their body shape and posture due to loss of muscle mass rather than reducing their weight, orMuscle weakness after childbirth or due to agingSuitable for those who are concerned about

Since it is not a treatment to directly reduce fat, it is difficult to expect an immediate effect on the number on the scale,Increasing muscle mass leads to a rise in basal metabolism。

Examples of combinations of medical EMS and other treatments
  • GLP-1 injection + medical EMS: maintain and increase muscle mass while losing weight
  • Fat cooling + medical EMS: Aim for a toned body while reducing fat at the same time
  • Used alone to recover muscle weakness after childbirth or due to aging

There is almost no pain or downtime, and you can receive the treatment while lying down, making it easy to continue even for those who have difficulty getting into the habit of exercising.

There are many cases where a synergistic effect is achieved by combining it with other treatments, for example, some people choose a plan that uses GLP-1 to lose weight while maintaining muscle mass using medical EMS.

After sorting out whether your problem is ``losing weight'' or ``getting in shape,'' consult your doctor before choosing a treatment.

Is there a possibility of rebound after treatment?

The ease of rebound varies greatly depending on the type of treatment.

Fat cooling and fat-dissolving injections are treatments that physically reduce the fat cells themselves, so the fat cells disappear with the treatment.fat cells never grow back。

On the other hand, even if the number of fat cells decreases, if the remaining cells enlarge, the body shape will collapse.Diet and exercise habits after treatmentinfluences the results.

Comparison of ease of rebound by treatment
  • Fat cooling/fat dissolving injection: Because the fat cells themselves are reduced, the cells do not return. However, enlargement of remaining cells may occur.
  • GLP-1 injection: Appetite returns after administration, so rebound is likely. It is important to improve lifestyle habits at the same time.
  • Common: Post-treatment diet and exercise habits determine the maintenance of long-term effects.

GLP-1 injection suppresses appetite and causes weight loss during administration, but appetite returns once administration is complete, so it is a procedure that is likely to cause weight gain again unless lifestyle improvements are made at the same time.

Regardless of the type of treatment, it is difficult to expect to maintain your body shape through treatment alone; reviewing your lifestyle habits, including diet and exercise, is essential to maintaining long-term results.

It is believed that being conscious of adjusting your lifestyle habits after the treatment is important for making the results stick.
